alerts.title: Slow Horses
facts: They filmed two versions of River's final scene, and one of them was a happy ending that never made it into the season.
Olivia Cooke's Sid is missing from the premiere because she was off shooting House of the Dragon.
The big Coe death sequence plays out in a bathroom, a bowling alley and a motorway service station, locations picked so the characters could be kept apart during the shootout.
alerts.nextSeason: Season 7 is already renewed (six episodes, adapting Mick Herron's Bad Actors) but Apple hasn't announced a date. Speculation: a new season has landed every year since 2022, so most likely sometime in 2027.
